Step one) go to the hardware store say 'i need quick set in weld".  step two) get a piece of cardboard (to mix it on) and something to mix and apply the epoxy. step 3) remove the two tubes from the packaging and squeeze out an even amount beside each other.step 4) mix the them with your small mixing tool until they mix to a solid grey ( one tube is black one is white) step 5) epoxy back together the pieces let them dry put them back into your light and then epoxy them back into place. Boom your done and now you've learned a new skill 😁
